name: Claret Fist
description: Hammer a fist loaded with deep red blood-qi into the target's ribs.

name: Bleeding Step
description: Sidestep on a bleeding pulse and leave a thin trail of blood-qi to mark the line of retreat.

name: Veinprick
description: Prick a surface vein with a fine point of qi so the vessel begins to weep.

name: Ruby Guard
description: Harden a ruby-red film of blood over the forearm to take a cut without parting.

name: Burst Capillary
description: Burst a net of capillaries beneath the skin with one pulse of qi to stagger the target.

name: Bleedout Mark
description: Brand a wound with a mark that keeps it open so the target slowly loses strength.

name: Gore Spray
description: Fling a thick spray of blood-charged qi from an open wound that scalds on contact.

name: Hemorrhage Wave
description: Send a wave of burst-vessel force through the ground and the air that opens small wounds on all it crosses.

name: Vessel Unraveling
description: Thread a hair of qi into a limb and unpick its vessels one by one until it goes limp and pale.

name: Exsanguinate
description: Open the target's blood to a long pull that drains its body of vitality through a single mark.

name: Heartpair Fist
description: Beat two pulses together in the chest and throw one fist on their joint weight.

name: Second Heart
description: Start a second rhythm of blood beside the first so the limbs draw on a doubled supply.

name: Parallel Beat
description: Move along two tracks of rhythm at once so each foot lands on its own beat.

name: Two-Track Surge
description: Push a surge along each arm on separate tracks and land both on the target as one.

name: Heartsync Guard
description: Beat both hearts in unison to hold a rigid guard against a drawn-out press.

name: Rebounding Heart
description: Let a blow strike the thickened chest and bounce its force back through the striker's own arm.

name: Doubled Circulation
description: Double the flow of blood through every limb for a span of breaths of greater speed and power.

name: Parallel Heartstorm
description: Hammer both hearts at the same instant and loose the storm of force in a ring around the user.

name: Heartshatter
description: Pour the force of two hearts into one touch that breaks the guard and jars the target's own pulse.

name: Hawk-Eye Pulse
description: Sharpen the senses on one pulse at a distance and hold it steady across a busy room.

name: Stooping Claw
description: Drop into a crouch and rake upward with curled fingers loaded with blood-qi.

name: Quarry Mark
description: Mark a target's pulse with a thread so that its heartbeat stays in sense wherever it runs.

name: Falcon Step
description: Push off both feet into a swift long glide that closes a gap in a single beat.

name: Gliding Guard
description: Glide the forearms along a blow and shed its force like a bird shedding wind.

name: Bloodscent
description: Catch the faint trace of blood in the air and follow it back to the wounded source.

name: Raptor Rake
description: Rake both hands across the target's flank so the sting weakens the whole side.

name: Hawk Tether
description: Fasten a line of qi from the user's wrist to the marked target and shorten it with each pull.

name: Keeneye Reading
description: Read every pulse in view at once and strike the one about to commit before it moves.

name: Ripping Stoop
description: Dive onto the marked target and rip through guard and vessel with a single hooked hand.

name: Scarlet Talon
description: Drive a talon of condensed blood-qi through the marked pulse and out the far side.

name: Soothing Flow
description: Pass a gentle flow of blood-warmth into a hurt ally or the self to ease and close it.

name: Rivulet Touch
description: Trace a thin rivulet of warm blood-qi along a gash to bind its edges for an ally or the self.

name: Pulse Calm
description: Slow a racing pulse in a frightened ally so their hands stop shaking and their aim steadies.

name: Wound Rinse
description: Rinse a fresh wound with a wash of clean blood-qi to clear grit and slow the bleeding.

name: Vein Map
description: Trace the veins of a patient with qi to map where blood pools and where it fails to reach.

name: Fever Wash
description: Wash a patient's blood in cool qi to carry fever and fouling out through the skin.

name: Silt Draw
description: Draw settled taint and silt from the blood of an ally or the self into one pooled spot.

name: Quiet Torrent
description: Pour a quiet torrent of vital blood-qi into a deep wound and watch it fill from the bottom.

name: Confluent Mend
description: Join the flows of two wounds and one healthy limb so the mend and the strength rise together.

name: Reawakening
description: Hammer the chest and flood a heart just stopped with blood-qi to restart it within a few breaths.

name: Convergent Mend
description: Gather every stream of the healer's blood-qi into one point and close a grievous wound while clearing its taint.

name: Vital Confluence
description: Draw together the vital blood of all present into one stream that pulls a fallen ally back from the edge.

name: Sheenskin
description: Smooth a film of polished blood over the skin so that light cuts glance off.

name: Sheen Parry
description: Flick a polished forearm across the line of a strike and throw it wide.

name: Sheen Step
description: Slide off the line of attack on a glassy step as if the ground were polished.

name: Reflecting Beat
description: Sound a faint pulse into the target and read the shape of the echo returned.

name: Blood Mirror
description: Raise a mirror of blood on the forearm that turns the shape of a strike back at its source.

name: Sheen Guard
description: Hold a polished guard that returns a part of each blow it takes to the one who struck.

name: Sheen Mend
description: Smooth a wound with a glassy film of blood-qi that seals the skin over it on an ally or the self.

name: Returning Crimson
description: Catch a heavy blow on the blood-mirror and send its force back as a counter-strike.

name: Azure Reflection
description: Spread a clear mirror guard over the whole body that bends a barrage back along its own lines.

name: Drinking Mirror
description: Drink the force of an attack into the mirror of the blood and return a share of it as a pulse.

name: Windblood Fist
description: Throw a fist swung on the wind with the hot blood of the body riding behind it.

name: Slipstream Step
description: Step into the draught behind a swinging blow and let it carry the body past.

name: Gust Jab
description: Jab two fingers on a sudden gust so the point lands before the guard can answer.

name: Sidewind Guard
description: Turn a blow aside with an arm that sweeps across its line like a cross-wind.

name: Windpulse Sense
description: Feel the pulses of nearby bodies carried on the moving air and tell which one rushes.

name: Hailing Spray
description: Hurl hail-hard droplets of blood-qi that rattle off guards and sting exposed skin.

name: Windcleave Surge
description: Cleave through the opponent's guard on a surge of wind and blood and finish a pace behind them.

name: Veinwind Bind
description: Wrap a vein of the target in a thread of wind that slows it by pulling against the pulse.

name: Tempest Heartbeat
description: Beat the heart to the rush of a tempest and release the whole beat in one strike.

name: Blood Gale
description: Send out a gale of blood-red qi that scours the ground and flings its victims aside.

name: Stormblood Rush
description: Vanish in a storm of blood-qi and reappear at the target's back in the instant of the blow.

name: Oathblood Fist
description: Throw a fist that carries the weight of an oath drawn from the user's own blood.

name: Pledge Fetter
description: Bind a target's wrist to the user's sworn word with a red thread that cannot be cut.

name: Covenant Guard
description: Hold a guard under a covenant not to yield so the blood thickens as the blow arrives.

name: Truthpulse
description: Feel through a held wrist whether the pulse beats true to a sworn word.

name: Oathbreak Pulse
description: Send a shock through the pulse of an oathbreaker that locks the breath in the chest.

name: Bondmark Rupture
description: Burst the mark of a sworn bond in a target's blood so that the wound will not close.

name: Vow Transfusion
description: Pass a measure of the user's sworn vitality into a pledged ally to close their wounds.

name: Sanguine Covenant
description: Draw a bound target into a covenant of blood so any strike on the user costs the striker equally.

name: Covenant Seal
description: Seal the target's blood-qi behind the covenant mark until the oath they broke is mended.

name: Bloodpledge
description: Bind a sworn pledge into a target's pulse so that breaking it drains their strength until they relent.

name: Ironbeat Guard
description: Harden the whole body to a single steady beat that shrugs off a heavy push.

name: Anchored Heart
description: Settle the heart on a deep slow beat that roots the stance against a shove or a throw.

name: Truebearing Brace
description: Brace the frame on its true bearing so the force of a blow runs through it into the ground.

name: Steady Rebound
description: Take a push on the steady chest and answer with a shove of the same weight.

name: Unshaken Pulse
description: Hold the pulse unshaken under a long press and lend that calm to a near ally.

name: Pulse Anchor
description: Drop an anchor of thickened blood into the soles that no sweep can lift.

name: Heartbound Aegis
description: Bind the aegis to the heartbeat itself so it renews with each beat and holds against sustained attack.

name: Immovable Beat
description: Hold a beat so firm that a charging foe is slowed and stopped against the user's frame.

name: Unyielding Heart
description: Take a blow into the open chest and bend its force into the steady beat as strength.

name: Windwarm Touch
description: Rest a hand on a wound and breathe warmth through it until the edges draw together.

name: Windbreath Mend
description: Breathe over a cut in time with the pulse until it dries and knits for an ally or the self.

name: Draught Rouse
description: Blow a cool draught over a faint ally's face and shake their blood awake.

name: Beat Mark
description: Keep part of the attention on a patient's heartbeat and note any change in its pace.

name: Turning Hand
description: Cup a hand over a patient's wound and thicken the wind to turn aside a glancing strike.

name: Gust Cleanse
description: Blow a cleansing gust through a wound to scatter taint and rot from the blood of an ally or the self.

name: Fever Wind
description: Fan a cool wind over a feverish patient and carry the heat out with each breath.

name: Stitching Wind
description: Draw the lips of a long wound together with a thread of wind and warm blood-qi.

name: Mending Gust
description: Breathe a single mending gust over a hurt ally and lift their strength for a short span.

name: Gale Revival
description: Send a gale into the lungs and a pulse into the heart of one who has only just stopped.

name: Wind-Fed Torrent
description: Pour a wind-fed torrent of vital blood-qi into a gravely hurt ally to close and strengthen.

name: Lifewind Surge
description: Raise a wind of living blood-qi over the fallen that calls back the just fallen within moments and mends their wounds.

name: Surge Hook
description: Swing a hook on a surge of blood that lands on the side of the jaw or ribs.

name: Gale Elbow
description: Drive the elbow forward in a short gale-fed arc that cracks the guard.

name: Redwind Kick
description: Kick low on a gust of hot blood and sweep the standing leg from under the target.

name: Ribbreak Shoulder
description: Slam the shoulder into the ribs behind a pulse of wind-driven blood.

name: Offbeat Lunge
description: Break the rhythm of a step and lunge on the offbeat before the guard can set.

name: Gale Maul
description: Maul the target with a blood-heavy hammer-fist that carries the push of the gale.

name: Redwind Barrage
description: Throw a barrage of fast blows that blow away the guard and leave the ribs open.

name: Surge Pierce
description: Pierce the open chest with a blood-hardened point driven by a hard surge of wind.

name: Bloodgale Spray
description: Spray a gale-driven mist of blood-qi that cuts like grit across the face.

name: Windrend Fist
description: Rend the guard with a fist that tears the air and the opponent's stance together.

name: Gale Torrent
description: Pour out a torrent of gale and blood that rolls over the field of fighters and knocks them flat.

name: Unwalled Onslaught
description: Rush forward with nothing held back and trade a guard for a flurry of surging blows.

name: Crimson Tempest
description: Spin into a tempest of blood and wind and strike every target around in a single sweep.
